headline.zh: 用AI设计酶，加速工业生物制造
headline.en: Design enzymes with AI for faster biomanufacturing

scenario.zh: 某化工企业希望开发一种耐高温的脂肪酶用于洗涤剂生产，传统筛选需要数月
scenario.en: A chemical company needs a heat-stable lipase for detergent production; traditional screening takes months

instruction.zh: 从已知序列出发，或让AI探索新序列空间
instruction.en: Start from a known sequence or let AI explore new sequence space

output.zh: 简报更新：基于Thermomyces酶骨架；AI将围绕已验证的催化位点优化
output.en: Brief updated: based on Thermomyces enzyme scaffold; AI will optimize around validated catalytic site

output.zh: 简报更新：探索非天然折叠；更高创新性但验证周期较长
output.en: Brief updated: exploring non-natural folds; higher innovation potential but longer validation cycle

instruction.zh: 平衡稳定性与催化效率的权重

output.zh: 模型建议12处突变，重点强化疏水核心；预测熔点提升至75°C
output.en: Model suggests 12 mutations reinforcing hydrophobic core; predicted melting point increase to 75°C

output.zh: 模型建议5处保守突变，活性位点构象保持；稳定性提升较温和
output.en: Model suggests 5 conservative mutations preserving active site geometry; moderate stability gain

instruction.zh: 查看两个AI生成变体的预测性能
instruction.en: Review predicted performance of two AI-generated variants

output.zh: 预测稳定性高，但表达量可能降低；适合后续定向进化
output.en: Predicted high stability but potentially lower expression; suitable for directed evolution

output.zh: 预测性能均衡，表达友好；推荐优先实验验证
output.en: Predicted balanced performance with expression-friendly profile; recommended for priority testing

instruction.zh: 确认要合成测试的序列
instruction.en: Confirm sequences for synthesis and testing

output.zh: 简报中已记录完整氨基酸序列与突变位点注释，可交付合成团队
output.en: Complete amino acid sequence with mutation annotations documented in brief for synthesis team

output.zh: 简报包含A、B两个序列及对照组设计，建议96孔板热稳定性筛选
output.en: Brief includes sequences A, B and control design; recommends 96-well thermal stability screen

takeaway.zh: Cradle用生成式AI将蛋白质工程周期从数月缩短至数周，已为工业酶、食品等领域客户服务
takeaway.en: Cradle uses generative AI to compress protein engineering cycles from months to weeks, serving clients in industrial enzymes and food sectors

initial.zh: 目标：耐高温脂肪酶（70°C稳定）；应用：液体洗涤剂；当前挑战：现有酶在55°C失活
initial.en: Target: heat-stable lipase (70°C stable); Application: liquid detergent; Current challenge: existing enzyme denatures at 55°C
